description: Official-calculator starter set (#63): the battery cases to enter into production calculators, each into at least two so three-way splits (PE vs UKMOD vs calculators) are adjudicable. A work list for manual, terms-compliant readings - never results; every entry is a current-law case whose policy year the named calculators actually compute (CALCULATOR_POLICY_YEARS); readings land as CaseResult rows with the reading date in oracle_version and the archived page cited in annotations.

entries.notes: gov.uk Child Benefit tax calculator states the charge at the GBP 70,000 taper midpoint; the income-tax estimator cross-checks the liability it rides on.
Top-of-taper boundary: the calculator must report a charge equal to the full one-child Child Benefit.
PT/UEL edges and salary sacrifice; the estimator handles the tax/NI side, the BOC confirms sacrifice reduces NI-able pay.
GBP 100k allowance taper; entitledto's tax module is the second reading.
Zero-allowance / additional-rate double boundary; a one-pound error in either rule is a discrete miss.
PSA ordering (1,000 at 0%, 500 at 20%); expected extra liability exactly GBP 100.
UC 55% taper and work allowance - the production calculators' home ground; three readings because taper-base construction (net of tax/NI) is a known divergence spot.
Greater London couple cap tier; the #21/#52 UC-deductions family depends on this machinery.

The post-abolition case under current law - the only member of the two-child family a production calculator can be asked to compute (its binding and multiple-birth siblings are evaluated in the registered pre_ab2025 world). Calculators updated for AB2025 must show three child elements.
